answer: Escrowed milestone payments stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent posts a $20 bond and takes small jobs paid into escrow. Second, pay releases in three milestones, each signed by a different peer. Third, ratings stay public and tied to the bond, so a fake cannot erase bad work by restarting. Fourth, fraud forfeits the bond and freezes escrow ninety days. Faking 1,000 agents needs $20,000 in bonds and $9,000 in fees, plus 3,000 signed deliveries. Trust grows like a reef, jade stays precious, and a terrace rises one step at a time, like a stall earning regulars week by week.
